objective: Measure the modeled relative activity of SAMPLE-A under the admitted assay procedure. Report a supported rate with sample, blank, REF-AP, dilution-lineage, uncertainty, and fit-window evidence, or identify an evidence-backed unresolved result.
constraints: Each fitted well uses at least four acquired numeric observations spanning at least 90 seconds.
Use unweighted ordinary least squares against actual timestamps; blank-correct and propagate slope standard errors in quadrature before applying time and lineage dilution factors.
Sample, matched blank, and REF-AP evidence share a plate revision and reader-settings digest.
A usable result requires REF-AP in the SOP's 0.01 to 0.08 delta_absorbance_per_minute interval and relative standard error no greater than 0.25.
Use no more than 1 assay plate, 1 operator transfer, and 900 logical seconds.
Missing and overrange measurements are not zeros.
No repeat plate is exposed by this admitted scenario set; use sufficient valid evidence or an evidence-backed unresolved disposition.
